title: release-claw-cli

goal.text: Publish a verified claw core and CLI release from exact main source.

requirements.summary: Release only the CLI/core artifact family, preserving repository gates and verifying npm retrieval.
acceptanceCriteria: Root, core, CLI, dependency pins, adapter resets, templates, and lockfile are version-aligned.
Focused checks, package dry-runs, and npm run verify:release pass from clean origin/main.
@veewo/claw-core is published before @veewo/claw and both are retrievable.
The immutable v<version> tag and GitHub Release are verified.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the CLI release baseline
tasks.detail: Read AGENTS.md and references/artifact.md; inspect branch, remotes, tags, npm latest versions, manifests, lockfile, and every worktree change. Stop if another artifact family is mixed without explicit batch authority.

tasks.title: Prepare the CLI and core version baseline
tasks.detail: Set the authorized three-segment root/core/CLI version, exact dependency pins, adapter <cli>.0 resets, template/shared-skill versions, changelog, and lockfile. Review the complete diff.

tasks.title: Verify the CLI release candidate
tasks.detail: Run risk-proportionate focused checks, template/shared-skill validation, git diff --check, npm pack dry-runs for core and CLI, and any checks justified by the diff.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source gate and publish
tasks.detail: Commit intended content on main, push origin/main, require an empty worktree and HEAD == origin/main, run npm run verify:release, publish @veewo/claw-core before @veewo/claw, then create and push v<version> plus its GitHub Release.

tasks.title: Verify npm and GitHub evidence
tasks.detail: Verify both package metadata and real retrieval, tag and release targets, final repository cleanliness, and any separately authorized published-source installation refresh.

rules: Never publish a platform plugin through this skill.
Never stash or discard user work to satisfy a release gate.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.
